subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — initial evidence packaging
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: BrightCart Legal <legal@brightcart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-03T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — initial evidence packaging

Hi Ana and BrightCart team,

Thanks for taking this on — excited to get you what you need to complete your vendor assessment. To keep things low-friction, here’s a concise initial ask for the SOC 2 Type II materials and guidance on how to share them. If you prefer, we can accept a short one-line reply (examples below) and then pull artifacts programmatically.

What we typically need up front (minimal bundle):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the audit period (please confirm exact start/end dates in the report header).
- Signed bridge letter or attestation if the report’s audit period doesn’t cover the window you need.
- Control mapping (spreadsheet or PDF) linking your controls to our SIG/CAIQ questions where applicable.
- Small redacted log samples or telemetry snapshots for a representative day (optional; help with coverage).

Preferred delivery options (choose one):
1) S3 presigned URL (48h link, encrypted at rest)
2) Google Drive shared folder with viewer access + expiration (we provide service account if easier)
3) Secure SFTP drop (we can provide credentials)

Redaction guidance: redact only PII or customer-identifying information — do not redact control names, policy titles, or dates. If you must redact, include a short bridge note explaining the reason and what was redacted.

Quick reply samples (pick one):
- "Attached: SOC2_TypeII.pdf, Bridge_Letter.docx, Controls.xlsx — S3 presigned URL to follow."
- "We will share via secure Drive — link expires 12/10/28. Contact: secops@brightcart.com"
- "We need to coordinate SFTP; can you provide credentials? ETA 12/06/28."

If helpful, I’ve included a short manifest template and a bridge-letter sample you can use as a starting point. If you have any compliance constraints (e.g., cannot share logs) let me know and we’ll accept the report + bridge letter only.

Next steps: please confirm preferred transfer method and the exact audit period covered in the report. If you’d like us to sign an NDA or access agreement before retrieving artifacts, we can do that as well.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Head of Trust & Safety (Security Partnerships)
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment placeholders: REDWOOD_TypeII_Manifest.csv, Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Template.docx, control_mapping_sample.xlsx]

From: BrightCart Legal <legal@brightcart.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCart Security Ops <secops@brightcart.com>
Date: 2028-12-03T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — initial evidence packaging

On Tue, Dec 3, 2028 at 9:02 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this on — excited to get you what you need to complete your vendor assessment.
> ...

Thanks Evelyn — we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a signed bridge letter. A few clarifying questions before we package:

1) Audit period: the report covers 2028-01-01 to 2028-06-30. Will that window work, or do you need coverage through a later date?
2) Transfer method: S3 presigned links are fine, but our security team prefers encrypted SFTP for brokered transfers — is that supported?
3) Redactions: we need confirmation about acceptable redaction for vendor customer names in log samples. We can provide sanitized telemetry with variable substitution. Is a short legend acceptable instead of raw logs?

We’ll plan to produce the PDF and bridge letter by 12/06/28 if that timeline works.

Best,
Ana Martinez
Director, Legal — BrightCart
legal@brightcart.com

[Internal note: secops@brightcart.com will prepare transfer options once we confirm.]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: BrightCart Legal <legal@brightcart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — initial evidence packaging

On Tue, Dec 3, 2028 at 10:15 AM BrightCart Legal <legal@brightcart.com> wrote:
> Thanks Evelyn — we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a signed bridge letter. A few clarifying questions...

Ana — perfect, that audit period (2028-01-01 to 2028-06-30) is acceptable for our initial review. If you later have a more recent Type II, we can request an updated package via your security portal.

Transfer: SFTP is fine — we can provision credentials on our end and send connection details. If you prefer S3 presigned links that works too; we just ask links be valid for 48–72 hours and protected with MFA on your side.

Redaction: a sanitized log sample with a short legend is fine. Please avoid removing control-relevant metadata (timestamps, control IDs, config names). If sensitive fields are redacted, include a one-line note describing what was redacted and why.

Attached for your convenience: a one-page manifest template and a bridge-letter sample you can edit. Below is a short packaging checklist you can paste into your response or use as the file listing.

Packaging checklist (copy/paste into reply):
- SOC2_TypeII_<vendor>.pdf — full report (required)
- Bridge_Letter_<vendor>.docx — signed if audit period does not cover required window (required if applicable)
- Controls_Mapping_<vendor>.xlsx or .pdf — short mapping to SIG/CAIQ items (recommended)
- Log_Sample_<vendor>_sanitized.txt — optional, include legend for redactions (recommended)

One-line reply templates (for busy reviewers):
- "Will share via SFTP: SOC2_TypeII.pdf, Bridge_Letter.docx (ETA 12/06/28)."
- "S3 presigned: https://s3.amazonaws.com/… (expires 12/08/28) — files included: SOC2.pdf, Controls.xlsx."

If you can send the SFTP details or a presigned link, Monica will complete retrieval and our security team will validate. Thanks again.

— Evelyn

[Attachments included: REDWOOD_TypeII_Manifest.csv, Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Template.docx, control_mapping_sample.xlsx]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-03T15:19:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — initial evidence packaging

Evelyn — I’ll own retrieval once Ana confirms the transfer method. Karthik, can you stand by to help with any redaction questions from BrightCart’s side and validate the control mapping when it arrives?

Plan:
- I’ll provision an SFTP user (expiry 12/12/28) and send creds to legal@brightcart.com unless they provide an S3 link.
- If they send a presigned link, I’ll pull and place artifacts into our secure bucket and update the Drive folder with a read-only copy for the reviewer.

One-line status update to send to BrightCart (suggested):
"Thanks — SFTP credentials will be sent to legal@brightcart.com within 2 hours. ETA for artifacts retrieval: 12/06/28."

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Vendor Security Operations | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
